newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: One-wk Slovak rev repo tender rate drops to 14.6%.
newsitem.headline: One-wk Slovak rev repo tender rate drops to 14.6%.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said the average rate at its seven-day securities reverse repurchase tender eased to 14.60 percent from 14.95 percent on Thursday.
The NBS added in a statement that it had drained funds totalling 1.27 billion crowns ($44.8 million).
The NBS said the maximum bid was 15.4 percent, while the minimum bid hit 10.5 percent.
The tender was fully subscribed with all 1.27 billion crowns worth of bids accepted, the NBS said.
NBS reverse repo rates have been declining since last Friday due to lower commercial bank bids.
On Thursday, the NBS said it cut the reverse repo rate to signal to the market that rates should fall.
